[[File:EnergyCoupler-TGG.png|thumb|right|250px|Energy coupler linking cargo to a Starhawk speeder bike]]
'''Energy couplers''' were technological devices with a variety of uses. Energy couplers could be used to provide power to energy containment systems, such as the cage [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Grizzid]] used to transport a [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The cage, located in his [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter's]] cargo hold, had energy couplers that were rigged to feed triple the amount of power to containment system.<ref name="Rancor">{{WEGCite|story=A Rancor Comes to Tatooine|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

Energy couplers could also be used to attach cargo to vehicles. Some [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|''Starhawk'' speeder bikes]] were equipped with energy couplers.<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] and a group of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] with energy couplers to transport [[Spice/Legends|spice]] they stole from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Gungan">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>
